$comment: Static MCP tool definitions for this repo's deterministic recurrence-surfacing capability. Phase A: there is NO live MCP server (see docs/adr/0032-agent-interop-static-surface.md). The tool maps 1:1 to detect_recurrence() in recurrence.py; the schemas mirror that function's real signature and return shape. Research/training prototype on synthetic data; surfaces and cites only — no clinical claim.

tools.name: detect_recurrence
tools.title: Detect recurrence (exact, librarian)
tools.description: Surface items that recur (>= min_count times) across a record's dated entries and cite provenance: record id, count, exact dates, and merged variants. Deterministic and defensive; exact-match by default with opt-in normalize/synonyms/fuzzy layers (each merge still cited in variants). Surfaces and cites only — no interpretation, severity, score, diagnosis, or recommendation. Wraps detect_recurrence() in recurrence.py.

records.description: Records to scan. Each record is {id, entries:[{date, item, source_span}]}; date is an ISO-8601 string (or empty), item is the surfaced label.

date.description: ISO-8601 date, or empty for undated.

source_span.description: Optional [start, end] char offsets into the source text (provenance).

min_count.description: Minimum occurrences for an item to be surfaced as a recurrence.

normalize.description: Opt-in: trim/collapse whitespace and case-fold before comparing.

synonyms.description: Opt-in caller-supplied {variant: canonical} map; never inferred by the engine.

fuzzy_cutoff.description: Opt-in difflib similarity cutoff (0..1) to merge near-duplicate lookalikes; off when omitted. Every merge is still cited in variants.

outputSchema.description: The function returns a list of recurrence hits; exposed here as the `hits` array. Each hit carries provenance only.

item.description: The label shown for the merged group.

dates.description: Sorted occurrence dates (an undated occurrence is "" and sorts first).

variants.description: The distinct original surface strings merged into this hit — the audit trail (length 1 for an exact v0 hit).
